figure.role: figures (skeletal) and decor (static): BC/N/ORM + TeamMask; neutral knobs; CUE parameters on CPD

base_marker.role: figure bases: textured or flat, team band from the vertex mask (R) or the side wall, InstanceIndex pips (G/B)

game_layer.role: game layer (rings, highlights, markers): unlit, EyeAdaptationInverse, CastShadow off on the component

ORM.value: AO 1, roughness 0.6 (153/255), metallic 0 = the constants of the former vertex-mask base material

TeamMaskNone.value: 0: no TeamColor on the figure (the former none mode)

TeamColor.meaning: rgb = team colour (linear, FromSRGBColor of the hex), a = weight over the MI TeamColor (0 = MI value)

InstanceIndex.meaning: fighter number 1..3 for the base pips (0 = MI InstanceIndex)

FxFlash.meaning: rgb = flash colour, a = intensity (emissive; 0 = off)

Fade.meaning: 0..1: base colour to luminance x fade.value (CUE-013 without Masked)

custom_primitive_data.rule: every slot is neutral at 0: a primitive that sets no Custom Primitive Data renders exactly like its MI

TeamDye.neutral: 0 = multiply (candidates' graph); 1 = dye: TeamColor x luminance(BC) x TeamDyeGain

EmissiveIntensity.neutral: scales FxFlash/Rim/pips, which are 0 by default

RimColor.source: fx.rim = card.cream #F9EBDB (hud-style-tokens.json); FX-05: the rim reads cream, hero MIs never override it

VertexMaskWeight.neutral: 0: vertex colours ignored (a mesh without them reads white)

SideBandNormalZMax.note: side wall = local vertex normal |z| below this

BandKeepsTexture.note: 0: flat team band; 1: BC x TeamColor

ExposureCompensationAlpha.note: EyeAdaptationInverse alpha: 1 = the game layer keeps its value at any exposure
